# TulipFleet Dispatcher

> TulipFleet is a B2B fleet management SaaS for logistics companies operating
> in the Netherlands and Belgium. This subdomain hosts the Dispatcher web
> app: live fleet tracking, task/dispatch management, driver and vehicle
> records, route and toll-cost optimization, and exception handling for
> fleet operators.

This is the authenticated operator application, not a content or marketing
site — most pages require a company login and show live, per-tenant
operational data (vehicle positions, tasks, drivers), so there is little
static content here for a crawler to index beyond this file and the public
sign-in page.

## Company

- Main site: https://tulipfleet.com/
- Privacy policy: https://tulipfleet.com/en/privacy/
- Terms of service: https://tulipfleet.com/en/terms/
- Contact: info@tulipfleet.com

## What TulipFleet does

- Real-time fleet location tracking (MQTT-based vehicle telemetry on a live map)
- Task and dispatch management for drivers
- Driver and vehicle master data, safety scoring, HGV/toll compliance
- Route optimization and cost/toll analytics for Dutch and Belgian road networks
- Exception monitoring and resolution workflow for fleet operators
